ISSUES_DESCRIPTION: Investigate issues that affect whether a site is available, then use the recovery action provided for the issue.
ISSUE_QUEUE_DESCRIPTION: Shows publishing and delivery issues that need attention.
DOMAINS_DESCRIPTION: Review whether active domains are verified and their certificates are ready.
STORAGE_DESCRIPTION: Check whether file storage is ready, then test the connection.
RULES_DESCRIPTION: Preview how a policy change could affect sites before applying it.
RULES_READINESS_DESCRIPTION: Shows the latest site availability and delivery suspension status reported by the responsible services.
ISSUE_RETRY_NOT_ELIGIBLE: This issue is not eligible for retry.
ISSUE_HOSTING_ACTION_REQUIRED: This recovery action is only available for site-availability issues.
ISSUE_RESTORE_NOT_ELIGIBLE: Restore delivery is available after recovery has been confirmed.
ISSUE_ACTION_PARTIAL_TITLE: Recovery action completed with issues remaining
ISSUE_ACTION_COMPLETED_DESCRIPTION: The responsible service completed the action and reported {{count}} target(s) that still failed.
ISSUE_ACTION_PARTIAL_DESCRIPTION: The responsible service completed the action, but {{count}} target(s) still need recovery.
DOMAIN_RECOVERY_NOT_ELIGIBLE: Ownership verification is available only for unverified custom domains.
DOMAIN_RECOVERY_DESCRIPTION: Ownership verification ran for {{hostname}}. Review the result before considering the certificate ready.
STORAGE_TEST_PASSED_DESCRIPTION: The storage service confirmed the connection test.
STORAGE_TEST_FAILED_DESCRIPTION: The storage service finished the test but reported a failure. Site delivery is not confirmed as ready.
POLICY_CURRENT_DESCRIPTION: Review the impact before applying a policy change.
POLICY_WINDOW_NOT_CONFIGURED: No site availability window is active right now.
POLICY_WINDOW_HELP: This affects future site availability changes. It does not change a current issue.
POLICY_PREVIEW_DESCRIPTION: The preview shows the proposed version and affected active delivery changes. It does not apply the change.
POLICY_PREVIEW_PARTIAL_DESCRIPTION: Review the affected delivery changes before applying this policy change.
POLICY_REASON_HELP: Your reason is saved with this policy change.
POLICY_APPLIED_DESCRIPTION: Version {{revision}} now keeps sites available for {{seconds}} seconds during {{count}} active delivery change(s).
POLICY_APPLY_PARTIAL_DESCRIPTION: The policy change was only partly applied. Review delivery issues before assuming all sites are back to normal.
RULES_EMPTY: No site availability or delivery suspension status is available yet.
POLICY_WINDOW_REQUIRED: Enter a whole number of at least one second.
POLICY_REASON_REQUIRED: Enter a reason before applying this policy change.
ACTION_PERMISSION_TITLE: You no longer have permission for this action
ACTION_PERMISSION_DESCRIPTION: Refresh your Platform access before trying again.
ACTION_CONFLICT_TITLE: This change needs a new review
ACTION_CONFLICT_DESCRIPTION: The reported status changed after this page was loaded. Refresh and create a new preview before applying again.
ACTION_FAILED_DESCRIPTION: The action may not have been completed. Review the diagnostic code and current status before trying again.
EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: There are no delivery records available in this view.
ERROR_DESCRIPTION: Delivery records couldn't be loaded. No sample data is shown in their place.
